title: NotebookRecordResult
description:
The merged verb's output union — one shape per kind.

Emitted as ``notebook_record.output.json``.

NotebookRecordConfigResult.description:
Echo of the journaled configuration, plus the loud late-record disclosure.

``warning`` is non-null when the audit already had journal entries at
record time: recording a config moves every view_sha, so prior sign-offs
will read stale — correct, disclosed behavior.

goal.description: Echo of the recorded audit-open goal utterance (null when none was recorded).
goal.title: Goal

task_axes.description: Echo of the recorded audit-open task-axis utterances (null when none were recorded).
task_axes.title: Task Axes

warning.description: Non-null when the audit_id already had journal entries (views signed, receipts recorded, ...) when the config was recorded: the recorded config enters every canonical view recompute, so EVERY view_sha moves and prior sign-offs will read stale against the new canonical view. Disclosed, never silent.
warning.title: Warning

NotebookRecordConfigResult.title: notebook-record-config output data

NotebookRecordReceiptResult.description:
Honest accounting of one record-receipt pass.

``recorded`` names the sections a receipt was journaled for; ``skipped`` names
every entry whose slug was not found in the parsed source.

recorded.description: Sections a render receipt was journaled for, in entry order.
recorded.title: Recorded

skipped.description: Entries NOT journaled — unknown-slug (no such section in source).
skipped.title: Skipped

NotebookRecordReceiptResult.title: notebook-record-receipt output data

NotebookRecordReceiptSkipped.description:
One entry that was NOT journaled, with the honest reason.

``reason`` is ``unknown-slug`` — the entry named a slug the parsed source
does not contain (a stale or mistyped slug), so there is no section sha to
bind a receipt against. Reported, never fatal.
NotebookRecordReceiptSkipped.title: notebook-record-receipt skipped entry

NotebookRecordedReceipt.description: One section a render receipt was journaled for this call.
NotebookRecordedReceipt.title: notebook-record-receipt recorded section
